h1: Custom Color-Changing Cups for Branded Events
lead: Choose a color-changing stadium or silicone cup and develop artwork around the starting and activated appearance. We provide free design and a visual mockup for your selected model.
html:
Review the two appearances

Specify the artwork that remains visible and the appearance that changes. A rendering explains the concept; the actual sample establishes the response on the chosen product.

Keep response claims model-specific

Do not select a cup from an animation alone. Temperature, appearance and care information belong to the approved model and sample, not to an assumed category-wide performance number.
